title: Sight Testing and Dispensing of Spectacles to Children and Young People in Special Educational Settings (SES) - South West
description: This notice is inform the market of an opportunity to deliver Sight Testing and Dispensing of Spectacles to Children and Young People in Special Educational Settings within the South West region, covering Devon, Cornwall and Isles of Scilly (CIOS), Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire (BNSSG) and Gloucestershire Integrated Care Boards (ICBs). BNSSG, Gloucestershire, Devon and CIOS ICBs ('the Commissioner') are the contracting authorities for this procurement. The Commissioner may be subject to a restructure of its functions during or following this procurement process. In such circumstances, the functions to which this contract relates may be transferred to a successor or replacement public body. Bidders will be informed of any such change, and any changes because of it. The procurement is divided into the following Lots: • Lot 1: BNSSG and Gloucestershire • Lot 2: Devon and CIOS The contract(s) term will be for 3 years and 5 months (inclusive of the mobilisation period) plus a possible extension of up to a period of a further 2 years. Both contract(s) are due to commence on 01 April 2027 with service delivery anticipated to commence from 01 September 2027. The annual contract value for Lot 1 is £306,000 with a total maximum contract value of £1,530,000 (including extension option). The annual contract value for Lot 2 is £350,000 with a total maximum contract value of £1,750,000 (including extension option). Interested parties who wish to take part in the procurement are invited to take part in an Invitation to Tender (ITT) process, based on the competitive 'open' procedure. All ITT responses must be returned by 12 noon on 10th December 2026. Interested providers will be able to view the opportunity and access the tender documentation via the 'Live Opportunities' list on the e-procurement system, Atamis, available on the following link: https://health-family.force.com/s/Welcome This exercise is being carried out by NHS South, Central and West Commissioning Support Unit (SCW) on behalf of the Commissioner. SCW is currently subject to restructuring, and the management of this procurement may therefore move to a successor at some point during the procurement process. Bidders will be informed of any such change, and any administrative changes because of it.

title: ICT-koulutukset
description: Hankinnan kohteena on ICT-koulutuspalvelut Helsingin kaupungin ja Helsingin Konsernihankinta Oy:n ilmoittautuneiden osakkaiden käyttöön. Nämä ovat DigiHelsinki Oy (3300938-6), Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (2379058-6), Helsingin Kaupunkitilat Oy (3226884-5), Helsingin Seniorisäätiö (1729947-5) ja Helsinki Partners Oy (3209009-8). Hankinta jakautuu kolmeen osa-alueeseen. Hankinnasta muodostetaan puitejärjestely seuraaville osa-alueille: Osa-alue 1 / Taso 1: Peruskäyttäjä, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. Osa-alue 2 / Taso 2A, Peruskäyttäjä, Taso 2B, Tehokäyttäjä ja Taso 2C, Ammattilainen, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. Osa-alue 3 / Taso 3, Asiantuntija, johon valitaan neljä (4) palveluntarjoajaa, ellei vaatimukset täyttäviä tarjoajia ole vähemmän. ICT-koulutuksilla tarkoitetaan tässä hankinnassa tieto- ja viestintäteknologiaan, digitaalisiin työvälineisiin, ohjelmistoihin, tietoturvaan, data-analytiikkaan, tekoälyyn sekä tietojärjestelmien käyttöön ja kehittämiseen liittyviä koulutuksia, valmennuksia ja työpajoja Tarjouksen voi jättää yhdelle tai useammalle osa-alueelle. Jokaiselle osa-alueelle tehdään erilliset valinnat. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo on kolme (3) miljoonaa euroa (alv 0%). Arvioitu arvo sisältää koko sopimuskauden eli neljä (4) vuotta ja sen arvioidaan jakautuvan osa-alueittain seuraavasti: osa-alue 1: 800 000 euroa osa-alue 2: 1 100 000 euroa osa-alue 3: 1 100 000 euroa. Tilaaja ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä., OSA-ALUE 1: TASO 1 TASO 1 Koulutukset toteutetaan tilaajan tiloissa tai etäyhteydellä. Tason 1 koulutuksiin kuuluvat muun muassa • Windows-peruskoulutukset mm. tietokoneen peruskäyttö • Microsoft 365 -sovellusten perusteet, kuten Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Forms ja Teams • Outlookin sähköposti- ja kalenterikäyttö • Microsoft 365 Copilotin perusteet työvälineenä • muut generatiivisen tekoälyn peruskoulutukset • internetin ja intranetin käyttö • Power BI Desktop peruskäyttö • Power BI Desktop peruskäyttö valmiiden raporttien käyttö • tietoturvan perusteet peruskäyttäjille • muut tilaajan vakioituun ICT-ympäristöön liittyvät peruskoulutukset Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde on kuvattu liitteessä 1 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus., OSA-ALUE 2: TASO 2 TASO 2A, Peruskäyttäjä Koulutukset toteutetaan toimittajan tiloissa. Tason 2A koulutuksiin kuuluvat muun muassa: • Windows-peruskoulutukset • Microsoft 365 -sovellusten perusteet, kuten Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Forms ja Teams • Outlookin sähköposti- ja kalenterikäyttö • Microsoft 365 Copilotin perusteet työvälineenä • muut generatiivisen tekoälyn peruskoulutukset • internetin ja intranetin käyttö • Power BI Desktop peruskäyttö • Power BI Desktop peruskäyttö valmiiden raporttien käyttö • tietoturvan perusteet peruskäyttäjille • muut tilaajan vakioituun ICT-ympäristöön liittyvät peruskoulutukset TASO 2B, Tehokäyttäjä Koulutukset voidaan toteuttaa tilaajan tai toimittajan tiloissa tai etäyhteydellä. Tason 2B koulutuksiin kuuluvat muun muassa: • SharePointin sisällöntuottaminen • Adobe-ohjelmistojen perus- ja jatkokoulutukset • Power BI Desktop vaativa käyttö • digikuvaus • viestintään liittyvät koulutukset • roolipohjaiset tekoälykoulutukset asiantuntijoille • kehotteiden laatimiseen liittyvät koulutukset • muut vastaavan vaativuustason koulutukset TASO 2C, Ammattilainen Koulutukset voidaan toteuttaa tilaajan tai toimittajan tiloissa tai etäyhteydellä. Tason 2C koulutuksiin kuuluvat muun muassa: - tietohallinnon ammattilaisille suunnatut koulutukset - tietoturvan ammattilaisille suunnatut tietoturvakoulutukset - ohjelmointiin liittyvät koulutukset - robotiikkaan ja tekoälyyn liittyvät tekniset koulutukset - muut vastaavan tasoiset koulutukset Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde on kuvattu liitteessä 1 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus., OSA-ALUE 3: TASO 3 TASO 3, Asiantuntija Tason 3 koulutukset voidaan toteuttaa tilaajan tai toimittajan tiloissa tai etäyhteydellä. Tason 3 koulutuksiin kuuluvat muun muassa: - tekoälyvalmennukset asiantuntijoille ja johdolle - projekti- ja hankekoulutukset - tuoteomistajakoulutukset - muut asiantuntijarooleja tukevat koulutukset sekä sertifiointiin johtavat koulutukset Sertifiointikokeet tai sertifikaatit eivät sisälly koulutuksen hintaan, ellei tarjouspyynnössä tai tilauksessa nimenomaisesti toisin ilmoiteta. Tarkemmin hankinnan kohde on kuvattu liitteessä 1 Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus.,

title: Belgium – Filing equipment – Aménagement des espaces de stockage du futur Heritage Center de la SNCB à Schaerbeek, afin d’assurer la conservation adéquate de diverses collections patrimoniales : rayonnages, meubles à tiroirs, ainsi que rayonnages pour textiles et tableaux
description: La conservation, la gestion et la mise à disposition des collections patrimoniales de la SNCB font partie de sa mission de service public. Dans ce cadre, le Service Documentation et Archives, actuellement établi rue de France 85 à 1060 Bruxelles, sera transféré vers le nouveau Heritage Center, situé place Princesse Élisabeth 7 à 1030 Schaerbeek. Le présent marché porte sur la fourniture et l’installation d’un système de stockage modulaire et flexible destiné aux nouveaux espaces de dépôt, comprenant des rayonnages d’archives, des meubles à tiroirs ainsi que des rayonnages pour tableaux et textiles. Le système de stockage doit permettre une utilisation optimale de l’espace disponible, être adapté à la conservation durable et sécurisée des collections patrimoniales concernées et pouvoir être adapté aux futurs besoins de stockage. Sur la base de l’étude de capacité réalisée par la SNCB, les besoins sont estimés à environ 4 300 mètres linéaires de tablettes, 3 meubles à tiroirs et une surface utile totale d’accrochage de 80 m² pour les rayonnages destinés aux tableaux et aux textiles. Les quantités mentionnées sont indicatives. Le déménagement des collections ne fait pas partie du présent marché.

title: NHSGGC Provision of Breastfeeding Support Services
description: NHS GGC recognises the important contribution that third-sector organisations can make through the provision of breastfeeding peer support. Peer support offers families access to people with relevant lived experience who can provide practical, social and emotional support, complementing the clinical and professional support provided by NHS services. The service will contribute to the implementation of the Scottish Government Breastfeeding and Infant Feeding Strategic Framework and NHS GGC's Infant Feeding Policy and will support the delivery and sustainability of UNICEF UK Baby Friendly standards. The successful provider will work in partnership with NHS GGC, Health and Social Care Partnerships (HSCPs), maternity, neonatal, health visiting, Family Nurse Partnership (FNP) and other relevant services to provide an integrated breastfeeding support offer across NHS GGC. The service will follow and develop the existing model of community breastfeeding peer support, including the delivery of breastfeeding/infant-feeding support groups, recruitment and training of peer volunteers and targeted engagement with communities experiencing inequalities.

title: Emergency Medical Evacuation Services
description: Global Affairs Canada is seeking to establish a contract for the provision of emergency medical evacuation and support services on a worldwide basis, twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week (i.e., 24/7) for Canadian government employees and their dependants assigned to Canada's missions abroad. Global Affairs Canada through its FSD Services and Policy Bureau is mandated to provide client oriented advice and administration of the Foreign Service Directives to all Canadian government employees and their dependants who are assigned to Canada's missions abroad and who are subject to the provisions of the Foreign Service Directives. Employees serving outside Canada are required to have comprehensive coverage under the Public Service Health Care Plan (PSHCP) for themselves and their dependants to ensure that they have sufficient health care coverage. As a result, standard health care coverage for employees and their dependants does not form part of the Department's service requirement. However, the PSHCP does not provide coverage for medical emergency evacuations and case management services. Therefore, the Department will require a Contractor to provide these services. The Contractor will provide a range of medical emergency evacuation and case management services on a worldwide, 24/7, basis including emergency medical evacuation, medical call centre services, medical case consultations and management, referrals, and health care travel consultations to employees and their dependants at all Canadian diplomatic missions and posts outside of Canada. The contractor’s services must be available in both Official Languages of Canada (English and French).

title: Enabling Technology for Future Missions
description: SPACE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM BACKGROUND The Space Technology Development Program (STDP) mandate is to formulate, implement and manage contracted out research and development (R&D) projects in response to identified needs. Its objectives are to develop and demonstrate strategic technologies that have a strong potential for reducing technical uncertainties for future Canadian space activities. The STDP will therefore support the development of technologies to meet the current and future needs of the Canadian Space Program. OBJECTIVES The objective of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to enable the development of Space Technologies that are in line with the Canadian Space Agency’s (CSA) priorities and mission roadmaps. For the Priority Technology (PT) specified herein (see APPENDIX A-5 of ANNEX A), the work solicited is the development and advancement of the technology (Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)), (see APPENDIX A-1 of ANNEX A) to reduce technical uncertainties and support approval and implementation of specific potential future space missions of interest to Canada.

description: Yhteisöllisen asuminen, kevyt ja tuetun asumisen palvelut, osa-alue 3: Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva / 1. uudelleen avaus Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Yhteisöllisen asumisen, kevyen ja tuetun asumisen palvelujen hankintamenettelyn 2489/2024 ensimmäiseen uudelleen avaukseen. Uudelleen avaus koskee osa-aluetta 3 Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki tarkoittaa henkilöstön läsnäoloa vuoden jokaisena päivänä palvelukuvauksessa määritellyllä tavalla. Päihteet sallivassa yksikössä päihteiden käyttöä ei varsinaisesti rajoiteta, mutta sen tuottamia haittoja ehkäistään ja vähennetään. Tarvittaessa yksikön henkilökunnan tulee tukea asiakasta kohti päihteettömyyttä. Hankittava palvelu on kuvattu tarkemmin palvelukuvauksessa. Uudelleen avaus koskee hankintamenettelyn osa-aluetta 3. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Uudelleen avauksen osalta hankinnan arvioitu arvonlisäveroton arvo on noin 2 000 000 euroa vuodessa. Arvio on suuntaa-antava eikä sido tilaajaa. Uudelleen avauksessa valitaan halvimman hinnan perusteella kolme (3) uutta yksikköä tuottamaan palvelua. Tilaajan tarve yksiköille painottuu Tampereen alueelle. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valitut kaksi (2) yksikköä jatkavat palvelua perustamisvaiheen hankintasopimusten mukaisesti ja niiden osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan. Kyseisten perustamisvaiheessa valittujen yksiköiden osalta palveluntuottajat voivat kuitenkin jättää tässä uudelleen avauksessa tarjouksen laskeakseen voimassa olevaa hintaa. Palveluntuottajarekisteri päivitetään uusien tarjousten perusteella. Palveluntuottajat luetellaan rekisterissä uuden vertailun mukaisessa sijajärjestyksessä. Hankintamenettelyn avaamisen ja uusien tarjousten myötä myös aiemmin valitun palveluntuottajan vertailun mukainen sijajärjestys saattaa muuttua uuden vertailun perusteella. Hankintamenettelyn uudelleen avauksen yhteydessä hyväksyttyjen palveluntuottajien sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027. Sopimuskausi on voimassa toistaiseksi. Palveluntuottajien on aloitettava palvelutuotanto viimeistään 1.9.2027. Sopimuksen voi irtisanoa hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ilmoitetuin irtisanomisehdoin. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valittujen palveluntuottajien osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan, eikä sopimuskauden pituuteen tule muutoksia tämän uudelleen avauksen myötä. Mahdolliset hinnanmuutokset päivitetään palveluntuottajarekisteriin. Tarjousten valinta- ja vertailuperusteet ovat tarkemmin kuvattuna tarjouspyynnön "Päätöksenteon perusteet"-kohdassa.,

buyer: Direktion für Sicherheit, Umwelt und Energie
title: Tierpark Bern Dählhölzli, Neu- und Ersatzbauten, 291 Architekturleistungen, Studienauftrag mit 2 Lose
description:
La Ville de Berne gère plusieurs installations zoologiques sous le nom de « Tierpark Bern » (Parc zoologique de Berne). Elle offre à la population des possibilités de détente et des expériences personnelles, transmet et développe des connaissances sur la faune et la flore, et sensibilise le public à la détention des animaux dans le respect de leurs besoins, ainsi qu’à la protection de la nature et des espèces. Le Tierpark Bern comprend notamment les sites du Dählhölzli et du Parc aux ours (Bären Park). Afin de répondre aux besoins d’un nombre croissant de visiteurs et d’assurer une détention des animaux adaptée à leurs besoins, des investissements sont prévus dans les infrastructures et les enclos existants ainsi que dans de nouvelles installations. Par ailleurs, des mesures sont envisagées pour améliorer les conditions de travail du personnel. Parallèlement, le Tierpark Bern entend accorder une attention accrue, à l’avenir, aux défis posés par le changement climatique et la perte de biodiversité. Le périmètre du projet abrite en outre des habitats et des espèces protégés par la Loi fédérale sur la protection de la nature et du paysage (LPN) ; leur préservation, ou une compensation équivalente, doit impérativement être prise en compte lors du développement du projet.


La réalisation de ces objectifs implique des transformations spatiales. Il s’agit de créer de nouvelles installations et de remplacer celles qui sont vétustes. De plus, l’accès au site du Dählhölzli doit être amélioré pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Cette démarche constitue un élément essentiel de la planification globale du Tierpark Bern pour la période 2023–2033, laquelle décrit en détail la vision et la stratégie de ce qui se veut être « le parc zoologique le plus charmant de Suisse ».

title: Renovate Building 1203-DOAS/AHU and Fire Suppression Water System, March Air Reserve Base, California
description: This solicitation is for construction services required for HVAC and Fire Suppression systems repair of Building 1203 at March Air Reserve Base, CA. This is an Invitation For Bid, sealed bid procurement. The solicitation notice will be posted to SAM.gov 4 November 2026 by Close of Business.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Louisville District hereby issues an Invitation for Bid (IFB), Solicitation No. W912QR27BA004, to renovate Building 1203-DOAS/AHU and Fire Suppression Water System, March Air Reserve Base, California. A description of the construction project is as follows:This work consists of, but is not limited to, installing a new Dedicated Outside Air System (DOAS) air handling unit, the replacement of Air Handling Unit (AHU-02) and the replacement of the existing waterline that ties the main waterline to Building 1203. The distance of waterline to be replaced is estimated to be 100-ft. Additional site-work will include a larger housekeeping pad, larger equipment access platform, and larger landscaped enclosure to accommodate the additional DOAS air handling unit. New outside air supply and return ductwork will be incorporated leading from the DOAS unit to the rooms served by AHU-02 providing direct-to-room ventilation. The Contract Duration is 500 calendar days from Administrative Notice to Proceed.TYPE OF CONTRACT AND NAICS: This IFB is intended to result in the award of one Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The North American Industrial Classification System Code (NAICS) for this effort is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction.TYPE OF SET-ASIDE: This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside.DISCUSSIONS: The Government intends to award without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussion should it be deemed in the be interest of the Government.CONSTRUCTION MAGNITUDE: The magnitude of this construction project is anticipated to be between $1 million and $5 million.REGISTRATIONS: Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the following database: System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors shall have and shall maintain an active registration in the SAM database at http://www.sam.gov to be eligible for a Government contract award. If the Offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity shall have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. If at the time of award an Offeror is not actively and successfully registered in the SAM database, the Government reserves the right to award to the next prospective Offeror. POINT-OF-CONTACT: The point-of-contact for this procurement is Rachael McClellan, Rachael.L.McClellan@usace.army.mil. PARTNERING WITH US: https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/Information regarding the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers process for settling requests for equitable adjustments and duration goals to achieve defeminization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found by going to https://www.usace.army.mil/Business-With-Us/Partnering/ and then clicking on: View FFP Contract Changes Playbook Here.

title: Army Contracting Command - Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG)Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for PdM WESS
description: Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Project Office/Customer Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Contracting Activity Army Contracting Command � Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) CSO Number Army Open Solicitation (AOS) - W9128Z-25-S-A002 Call for Solution Title Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Contracting Points of Contact Contracting Officer: Licinda Peters Email: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Keith Magaw Email: keith.a.magaw.civ@army.mil Questions Due Date/Time 05 November 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Solution Brief Due Date/Time 10 December 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Submit Solution Brief Via Sam.gov and AOS Controlled by U.S. Army Controlled by: PdM WESS CUI Category: Operations Security (OPSEC) Limited Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Objective 5: Integrated Test and Diagnostics: The DIFS shall incorporate built-in test capabilities to generate, capture, and analyze Digital IF streams to allow for rapid troubleshooting, performance verification (e.g., Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) & spectral purity), and subsystem health monitoring with minimal operational burden and with on-site test equipment. Objective 6: Resilient and Maintainable Design (Resilient): The commercial solution shall be designed for high availability Ai ? 0.9998) a long service life (15 years), and rapid maintainability (MTTR ? 30 minutes), using standard line-replaceable items (LRIs). title: Mesh and Hydrodynamic Framework for Shellfish Water Classification Program
description: This solicitation aims to collect and organize physical oceanographic data into a usable format for Environment and Climate Change Canada. The data will support the development of accurate hydrodynamic models to predict fecal coliform contamination in coastal and intertidal areas during both planned and unplanned events. These models and frameworks will enable ECCC Shellfish Water Classification Program (ECCC-SWCP) Engineers to evaluate potential water quality conditions in shellfish harvest waters near possible sanitary pollution sources. The information generated from this project will support the ECCC delivery of a wastewater assessment and hydrodynamic modelling to inform shellfish harvesters on sanitary pollution contamination.

Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC)
description: ****Related Prior Solicitation Number W911XK26RA012 and W911XK27BA002**** The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Detroit District is seeking contractors with the capability to provide environmental (mechanical) dredging and placement of contaminated sediment construction services in the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel (MCUTC) located in Riverview, Michigan. The project consist of work associated with the environmental maintenance dredging of the Monguagon Creek Upper Trenton Channel located in Riverview, Michigan. There are no options included with the solicitation. The channel is situated just south of Bridge Road and the Grosse Ile Toll Bridge. The primary goal of the project is to remove contaminated sediment from Sediment Management Area 1 (maximum 4 feet depth) and Area 2 (maxi-mum 25 feet depth). Approximately 28,100 cubic yards of material is planned to be re-moved using mechanical dredging means with transport and placement of the contaminated dredged material into Cell 5 of the Pointe Mouillee Confined Disposal Facility (CDF).

ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. title: Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS)
description: The Sources Sought results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this solicitation will be unrestricted competition or a small business set-aside for C-Type contract to fulfill Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) requirements. The Government is assessing the capability of companies that may possess the expertise to competently and competitively respond to the following requirements for the SCARS program: For the SCARS Program, the contractor shall possess the capabilities to fulfill 1) Security Operations Center (SOC) Operations, 2) Remote Assessment & Authorization, 3) Software Patching Baseline Integrity, 4) Maintain a SCARS Library, 5) Edge Virtualization & Modern Deployment on SCARS On-Premise Equipment (OPE), 6) Network Integration & Management, 7) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), 8) Governance of Architecture Standards, 9) Enterprise Logistics & Fielding, 10) Data Requirements and 11) Security Requirements. The contract will commence CY2030 with an anticipated transition period up to six (6) months leading to full operational performance in CY 2031. The anticipated structure includes a 4-year base period with six 1-year option periods and an optional 6-month extension of services (RFO 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services). All projected dates and contact structures are notional and subject to change based on market research and acquisition strategy approval. title: Request for Information (RFI) for the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP)
description: FEMA is modernizing the National Flood Insurance Program to improve how it assesses and communicates flood risk, prices and delivers flood insurance, manages floodplains, and provides mitigation assistance. The goal is to help individuals, communities, states, and private-sector partners better understand and reduce flood risk while using policyholder and taxpayer funds efficiently. To support this effort, FEMA is integrating staff, initiatives, and support structures into a more unified NFIP operating model. The draft contract support model described in the RFI pursues those outcomes. Work will be grouped into several categories described in the RFI. Not all current NFIP support contracts will be recompeted immediately. This document also identifies selected support structures and contracts that are not currently within the scope of this RFI to provide a more complete picture of the NFIP support environment. Please see attached RFI for complete details.

description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) For Manufacturing/Procurement of Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly Noun NSN Part Number Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly 1650-01-187-9395HL 205-076-056-107 CAUTION: The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the data, expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualification requirements to manufacture/procure the Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly, which is applicable to the TH-1H Helicopter. The Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly has an Acquisition Method Code (AMC)/ Acquisition Method Suffix Code (AMSC) code of 1/C.AMC 1: Suitable for competitive acquisition for the second or subsequent time. AMSC C: This part requires engineering source approval by the design control activity in order to maintain the quality of the part. Existing unique design capability, engineering skills, and manufacturing knowledge by the qualified source(s) require acquisition of the part from the approved source(s). The approved source(s) retain data rights, manufacturing knowledge, or technical data that are not economically available to the Government, and the data or knowledge is essential to maintaining the quality of the part. An alternate source must qualify in accordance with the design control activity's procedures, as approved by the cognizant Government engineering activity. The qualification procedures must be approved by the Government engineering activity having jurisdiction over the part in the intended application. See Attachment 1 (Source Qualification Statement). If one source is approved, AMCs 3, 4, or 5 are valid. If at least two sources are approved or if data is adequate for an alternate source to qualify in accordance with the design control activity's procedures, AMCs 1 or 2 are valid. The technical data required to manufacture the Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is not owned by the Government. It has been determined to be uneconomical to buy the data or rights to the data. It is uneconomical to reverse engineer the part. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for the TH-1H Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is Woodward HRT, Inc. (CAGE: 81873). The OEM for the TH-1H Helicopter is Bell Textron, Inc. (CAGE: 97499) The Government has determined that this assembly is a commercial item as defined in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) 2.101. Commercial item descriptions, commercial vendor catalog or price lists or commercial manuals assigned a technical manual number apply. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) For Manufacturing/Procurement of Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly PURPOSE/DESCRIPTION The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualification requirements to manufacture/procure the Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly, applicable to the TH-1H Helicopter. NOUN NSN P/N Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly 1650-01-187-9395HL 205-076-056-107 This requirement is for procurement/manufacture services. Our procurement strategy is a five-year Indefinite-Delivery Requirements type contract (basic 1-year plus four 1-year ordering periods) and will continue through FY33. The projected quantities will be Best Estimated Quantities (BEQ) of 32 each for the basic year and 28-38 each for the outyears. The Government�s need for procurement services is required to support current combat search and rescue missions. The TH-1H Helicopter is used by the Air Force to train helicopter pilots. This Linear Actuating Cylinder Assembly is part of the TH-1H helicopter's flight control systems. These are a series of mechanical linkages, actuated by conventional controls and are used to control flight attitude and direction. This actuator provides hydraulic assisted cyclic input from the pilot to the main rotor through the swashplate and collective input through the collective levers and scissor hub. The hydraulic actuator has an irreversible valve to reduce feedback forces and provide for minimum use of controls in event of hydraulic boost failure. The Cylinder Assembly is an Aviation Critical Safety Item (CSI). It must provide hydraulic-assisted cyclic input from the pilot to the main rotor. Failure to achieve its designed function will result in unacceptable probability of a class-A mishap, thus increasing the likelihood of loss of life. title: Industry Day - USACE SPK Geotechnical Drilling and Laboratory Services
description: Special Notice: Virtual Industry Day Event Schedule & Platform Date of Event: December 10, 2026 (Thursday) Time: 1:00 PM � 2:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) Location/Platform: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (see below for details) Purpose of Event The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District (USACE-SPK) is pleased to announce a virtual Industry Day on December 10, 2026. The purpose of this session is to provide industry partners with a comprehensive overview of the upcoming Geotechnical Drilling Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Government will present details regarding program requirements, anticipated geographic scope, proposed technical evaluation factors (such as specialized rig fleet inventory and AASHTO/USACE MTC laboratory accreditation standards), and the tentative acquisition milestone schedule. USACE-SPK anticipates issuing a formal solicitation under NAICS 541360in February 2027., and highly encourage participation from regional small businesses, prospective joint venture partners, and specialty subcontractors who intend to compete. Scope of Work and Technical Capabilities USACE-SPK seeks firms with the capabilities to provide comprehensive geotechnical drilling, cone penetrometer testing (CPT) services, and test-pit excavations utilizing backhoes and track hoes. The principal features of the work encompass soil drilling and sampling utilizing hollow-stem flight augers, solid-stem flight augers, mud-rotary, air-rotary, and percussion drilling methods, including ODEX, Down-hole Casing Advance Systems, or other specialized percussion drilling systems. Contract requirements will also mandate sonic drilling and sampling, alongside rock core drilling and sampling of up to 6-inch diameter using wireline or conventional diamond-impregnated drill bits. Soil sampling operations will require standard penetrometers and other split-barrel samplers up to 3-inch-diameter, as well as undisturbed soil sampling using Shelby push tubes and Pitcher barrels with Pitcher tubes. Field operations will further include CPT testing, piezometer and inclinometer installations, hydraulic pressure testing associated with rock core drilling, and observation well installation and development, which includes pump, permeability, and percolation testing. Contractors will be responsible for generating all associated documentation, to include detailed drill logs, trench or test-pit logs, as-built diagrams for all instrumentation and well installations, and percolation test records. Additionally, the contractor must occasionally furnish the professional services of a registered, licensed Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer. Furthermore, firms must possess the capability to provide certified geotechnical laboratory services. The required testing scope includes moisture content, soil classification, sieve analysis, hydrometer, Atterberg limits, consolidation, triaxial testing, direct shear, California Bearing Ratio (CBR), organic content, and Specific Gravity. To ensure data integrity, all laboratory testing must be performed by a facility accredited by the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) in accordance with the corresponding ASTM standards. Finally, the laboratory must be, or successfully become, validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) for all requested testing methods. description: NASA Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) Launch Services 2026 On-Ramp The NASA Venture-Class Acquisition of Dedicated and Rideshare (VADR) Launch Services Request for Proposal (RFP) was issued on May 27, 2021 and remains open for a period of five years from the effective date through the use of an innovative on-ramp provision found in Section 2.11, Clause 2.11.1. The VADR contract�s ordering period remains valid through five years from date of contract award. Currently, there are 13 eligible providers as part of the Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ). These providers are Arrow Science and Technology, LLC, Astra Space, Inc., Blue Origin, LLC, Firefly Aerospace, Inc., Impulse Space, Inc., L2 Solutions, LLC, Momentus Space, LLC, Northrup Grumman System Corp., Phantom Space Corp., Relativity Space, Inc., Rocket Lab USA, Inc., Space Exploration Technologies, Corp., and United Launch Services, LLC. During the life of the solicitation and at the time established via synopsis, the Government will accept proposals from launch service providers for new IDIQ contracts. At a minimum, launch services proposed under VADR require the below: 1. Launch site agreements for at least one launch site to be used in support of task orders awarded under this contract. 2. Evidence of at least one of the following: Launch attempt (intentional ignition) of common launch vehicle configuration being proposed including, but not limited to, the outcome of the launch attempt Successful launch reaching an altitude of 100km or greater (can include any launch vehicle in the Offeror�s fleet) Development tests demonstrating at least 50% of the flight thrust at the complete full-scale single engine assembly level for all core stage engines of the common launch vehicle configuration being proposed. 3. If Offeror is proposing to use a launch vehicle provided by another company e.g., broker services, transfer vehicle, agreements will be required for each proposed vehicle. Original RFP link: https://sam.gov/opp/587b4fae322942b292baccda3098ae13/view (copy and paste into browser) The anticipated RFP will be restricted to domestic sources as described below: DOMESTIC SOURCE CRITERIA In addition to the certification regarding United States commercial provider of space transportation services (Public Law 105?303, Title II, Section 201), the Contractor shall continue to comply with domestic source criteria established below and with United States National Space Transportation Policy, dated November 21, 2013. Failure to comply with the criteria may be grounds for �Termination for Cause� in accordance with FAR 52.212?4(m). Participation in this procurement is restricted to prime Contractors from the United States launch vehicle/services industry. �United States industry� means any corporation, partnership, joint venture, association, or other entity which is organized or existing under the laws of the United States or any State, and whose controlling interest is held by United States citizens. �Launch services� means all services required in the performance of this contract, excluding those necessary to produce or manufacture launch vehicles, its components and other equipment and facilities required in the performance of the contract. �Controlling interest� means ownership of an amount of equity in such entity sufficient to direct management or to void transactions entered into by management. Ownership of at least fifty?one (51) percent of the equity creates a rebuttable presumption that such interest is controlling; however, the ultimate determination as to whether the interest is controlling resides with NASA. The Contractor shall provide in the performance of this contract launch vehicles that are domestic end products. The launch vehicle shall be a domestic end product only if the cost of its components, mined, produced or manufactured in the United States exceeds 50 percent of the cost of all its components. The cost of each component includes transportation costs to the place of incorporation into the launch vehicle and any applicable duty (whether or not a duty?free entry certificate is issued). �Components,� as used in this contract clause, means those materials and supplies directly incorporated into the end product. The Contractor shall provide, in the performance of this contract, domestic launch services. Launch services shall be considered to be domestic if the cost for launch services performed by United States industry sources exceeds 50 percent of the cost of the total required launch services. It is requested that any interested party notify NASA of intent to submit a proposal during this on-ramp period as well as a description of the launch vehicle configuration(s) you intend to propose and current flight manifest. If no viable responses are received, NASA will not conduct a 2026 VADR On-Ramp. An ombudsman has been appointed in accordance with NFS 1852.215-84.

title: Enhanced Mobile Satellite Services (EMSS) Equipment, Provisioning and Customer Care Help Desk Support
description: The United States Space Force (USSF) provides United States Government (USG) and other sponsored customers with satellite communication services through a dedicated, government-controlled gateway. The secure gateway communicates with the contracted commercial Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellation, and traffic processed through the secure gateway may be routed through secure government networks, public telephone networks, or other third-party networks. The program provides cradle-to-grave services and support to its customers, including baseline network airtime access, sale and provisioning of authorized devices, 24/7/365 dedicated help-desk support, enhanced Government capabilities such as encrypted communications, comprehensive operation and maintenance of the secure gateway, and other services. The objective of this possible follow-on effort is to deliver provisioning support and 24/7/365 dedicated help desk support to all authorized EMSS customers, including the Department of War (DoW), Federal Government, State and Local Government, approved foreign and allied governments, and other sponsored customers. The contractor may be required to provide EMSS Service Management services including Telecommunications Service Order (TSO) order management, warranty support, inventory management, supply chain functions, sub-contract management, provisioning activities, gateway liaison services, Return Material Authorization support, reporting, and program management. The scope includes provisioning, invoicing, record management, and customer care services for users who access the commercial satellite constellation through the secure gateway. Services include Telephony (Voice), Data Transmission (Circuit and Packet Switched), Short Burst Data messaging, Tactical Push-to-Talk voice and data, Paging and Alerting, Multicast Data Broadcasts, High-Speed Broadband services, Secure Voice, enhancements/evolutions of those services, and additional commercial services introduced during the period of performance and included under separately managed baseline access agreements. The Performance Work Statement (PES) contained in this posting is a secured attachment. To get access please submit a request through SAM.gov, including at a minimium POC name/contact information, vendor/entity name and CAGE code. Only vendors with Active SAM Registration will be considered for granted access and the Government reserves the right to deny access as it sees fit. These additional security measures are to comply with SF/SSC PA guidance.

title: Udbud af Rehabiliteringsydelser på specialiseret niveau
description: Kommende Region Østdanmark udbyder en kontrakt vedrørende levering af specialiseret rehabilitering til patienter med behov for et intensivt, tværfagligt og specialiseret rehabiliteringsforløb. Formålet med udbuddet er at sikre regionens patienter adgang til rehabiliteringsydelser af høj faglig kvalitet, leveret af leverandører med de nødvendige specialiserede kompetencer, kapacitet og organisatoriske rammer. Leverandøren skal understøtte sammenhængende patientforløb gennem tæt samarbejde og koordinering med regionens hospitaler, kommuner og øvrige relevante aktører. Ydelserne omfatter døgnbaserede rehabiliteringsforløb for patienter, der efter sygehusbehandling har behov for fortsat specialiseret rehabilitering med henblik på at opnå størst mulig funktionsevne, selvstændighed og livskvalitet. Udbuddet gennemføres af Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland på vegne af den kommende Region Østdanmark, som vil være kontraktpart ved kontraktens ikrafttrædelse.

description: Unter dem Vorbehalt der Bereitstellung von Haushaltsmitteln in der erforderlichen Höhe besteht folgender Bedarf: 86.000 Paar Laufsocken gem. TL-B 214, Ausgabe 10/2026 Vertragszeitraum: bis 09.05.2029; 2 x 12 Monate Option. Am 01. Januar 2014 ist das Niedersächsische Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe von öffentlichen Aufträgen (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz - NTVergG) in Kraft getreten. Dieses Gesetz soll einen fairen Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge gewährleisten sowie die umwelt- und sozialveträgliche Beschaffung durch die öffentliche Hand fördern. Das NTVergG findet Anwendung auf alle öffentlichen Aufträge über Bau-, Dienst- und Lieferleistungen, einschließlich Dienstleistungen im Bereich des öffentlichen Personenverkehrs (ÖPNV) - ab einem geschätzten Auftragswert von 20.000,00 EUR (netto). Die Vergabe des Auftrags erfolgt gem. § 3 Absatz 1 NTVergG nach den Regelungen der Unterschwellenvergabeordnung (UVgO) vom 2. Februar 2017. Auf § 2 UVgO (Grundsätze der Vergabe) wird hingewiesen. Des Weiteren wird auf einige Grundsatzregelungen des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen (GWB), insbesondere § 97 Abs. 1 bis 6 GWB, verwiesen. Das Angebot ist elektronisch in Textform, über die Vergabeplattform, einzureichen. *NTVergG = Niedersächsisches Gesetz zur Sicherung von Tariftreue und Wettbewerb bei der Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge (Niedersächsisches Tariftreue- und Vergabegesetz) in der Fassung vom 20.01.2020.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Planungsleistungen für das Projekt Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Multifunktionshalle
description: Leistungen: Im Rahmen dieses Vergabeverfahrens sollen Planungsleistungen für das Projekt Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Multifunktionshalle in Pollenfeld vergeben werden. Verfahrensgegenständlich sind die folgenden Leistungen: Grundleistungen der Objektplanung, Leistungsbilder Gebäude und Innenräume, HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1 bis 9; Erstellung Brandschutznachweis gemäß § 11 BauVorlV (Besondere Leistung); Energieberatung einschl. Beratung zu KfW-Förderung und Erstellung des GEG-Nachweises (besondere Leistung); Vermessung des Baugrundstücks im Zuge der Planung (besondere Leistung); Durchführung von Planungsworkshop(s) (besondere Leistung); vertiefte Kostenschätzung in Bezug auf das Raumprogramm, die es ermöglicht, verschiedene Varianten raumbezogener Einsparpotentiale darzustellen, und die alle Anforderungswünsche des Arbeitskreises für die Multifunktionshalle und damit verbundene Kostensteigerungen bzw. Einsparpotentiale berücksichtigt (besondere Leistung); Überwachen der Mängelbeseitigung innerhalb der Verjährungsfrist (besondere Leistung). Die Beauftragung erfolgt stufenweise nach Abruf. Zum Baugrundstück: Der Neubau soll auf dem Grundstück mit der Flurnummer 354, Gemarkung Preith, erfolgen. Das Grundstück steht im Eigentum des Auftraggebers und ist aktuell unbebaut sowie nicht erschlossen. Der Bereich des Grundstücks, auf dem der Neubau entstehen soll, wird derzeit vom Auftraggeber überplant. Das Bebauungsplanverfahren zum Bebauungsplan Preith Nr. 30 „Gemeindebedarf am Zachenweg“ befindet sich in der Phase der zweiten Auslegung und wird voraussichtlich Ende 2026 abgeschlossen sein. Zum Neubau: Die Maßnahme umfasst den Neubau eines Feuerwehrhauses mit Fahrzeughalle, Einsatz- und Umkleidebereichen, Schulungs- und Verwaltungsbereichen, Werkstatt, Lagerflächen, Technikflächen sowie Außenanlagen mit Übungshof und Stellplätzen. Ebenfalls soll das Feuerwehrgerätehaus noch eine Multifunktionshalle als Anbau erhalten. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt die Herstellung eines funktionalen und wirtschaftlichen Neubaus mit überwiegend robustem und nachhaltigem „LowTech“-Ansatz. Vorgesehen sind kompakte Baukörperstrukturen, langlebige Materialien sowie ein wartungsarmer Gebäudebetrieb. Besondere Anforderungen ergeben sich aus der Nutzung als kritische Infrastruktur, Betriebssicherheit sowie den feuerwehrspezifischen Funktionsabläufen. Stand der Planungen: Der Auftraggeber hat im Vorfeld des Verfahrens folgende Planungen / Studien erstellen lassen: Entwurf einer Raumaufteilung mit Raumprogramm, der allerdings einen anderen Projektstandort betrifft. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, an den Raumfunktionen und den jeweiligen Raumgrößen des Entwurfs festzuhalten. Die Raumaufteilung wird jedoch an den aktuellen Standort anzupassen und zu ändern sein, wobei sich Änderungswünsche auch aus Besichtigung anderer Häuser ableiten werden. Zu Beginn des Planungsauftrages hat der Auftragnehmer die Änderungswünsche gemeinsam mit Nutzern und Auftraggeber zu prüfen, zu validieren und ggf. in die Grundlage Raumprogramm einzuarbeiten. Kosten und Termine: Die Kosten des Projekts (Bau- und Planungskosten) werden derzeit auf rund 4,5 Mio. € brutto geschätzt. Die Schätzung basiert auf der Annahme, dass vorhandene Einsparpotentiale realisiert werden, was derzeit Ziel des Auftraggebers ist. Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, für das Projekt Zuwendungen zu erlangen, insbesondere Zuwendungen des Freistaates Bayern zur Förderung des kommunalen Feuerwehrwesens, LAG-Förderung, BAFA-Förderung etc. Der Auftraggeber geht derzeit von folgendem Projektablauf aus: Planungsbeginn: II. Quartal 2027, sofort nach Zuschlagserteilung; Einreichung Bauantrag: IV. Quartal 2027; Ausschreibung der Bauleistungen: IV. Quartal 2027; Voraussichtlicher Baubeginn: II. Quartal 2028; Voraussichtliche Fertigstellung/Inbetriebnahme: Anfang/Mitte 2030. Zum Ablauf der Planung gilt Folgendes: Im Rahmen der HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1 und 2 soll zunächst das Feuerwehr haus auf Basis des bereits vorliegenden Raumprogramms und der Raumaufteilung, die noch Änderungen unterliegen wird, sowie das gesamte Raumprogramm für die Multifunktionshalle nach den Anforderungswünschen des Arbeitskreises geplant werden. Synergien sind hierbei bestmöglich einzuplanen. So kann beispielsweise ein separater Schulungsraum für die Feuerwehr entfallen, da hierfür die Multifunktionshalle mitbenutzt werden kann. Nach Abschluss der HOAI-Leistungsphase 2 und Vorliegen der vertieften Kostenschätzung wird die Vorplanung im Gemeinderat des Auftraggebers evaluiert werden. Die Kostenschätzung ist so aufzubereiten, dass sie es ermöglicht, verschiede Varianten raumbezogener Einsparpotentiale darzustellen. Die Kostenschätzung hat auch alle Anforderungswünsche des Arbeitskreises für die Multifunktionshalle und damit verbundene Kostensteigerungen bzw. Einsparpotentiale zu berücksichtigen. Der Gemeinderat wird im Zuge der Evaluierung eine Optimierung der Planung sowie eine Anpassung und ggf. Reduzierung des Raumprogramms vornehmen. Im Falle des Abrufes wird in der HOAI-Leistungsphase 3 mit einer entsprechend angepassten und ggf. reduzierten Planung weitergeplant. Während der gesamten Planungsphase sind von Auftragnehmer sowohl der Gemeinderat als auch die Feuerwehr als auch der zuständige Arbeitskreis eng miteinzubeziehen.

title: Sweden – IT software package – Framtidens verksamhetssystem, planeringssystem och digitala lås
description: Karlstads kommun avser att upphandla Framtidens verksamhetssystem, planeringssystem och digitala lås som en samlad helhetslösning. Upphandlingen omfattar ett totalåtagande från Leverantören inom efterfrågade uppdragsområden. Leverantören ansvarar i sin helhet för integrationen mellan egna system och eventuella samarbetspartners/underleverantörers system. Vård- och omsorgsnämnden är inom Karlstads kommun ansvarig för kommunens äldreomsorg inom Socialtjänstlagen (SoL) och verksamheter för personer med funktionsnedsättning enligt Lagen om stöd och service till vissa funktionshindrade (LSS). Arbetsmarknads- och socialnämnden är inom Karlstads kommun ansvarig för kommunens individ- och familjeomsorg inom Socialtjänstlagen (SoL) och verksamheter för personer med funktionsnedsättning enligt Lagen om stöd och service till vissa funktionshindrade (LSS), Lag med särskilda bestämmelser om vård av unga (LVU), Lag om vård av missbrukare i vissa fall (LVM). Vård- och omsorgsnämnden är också ansvarig för den kommunala hälso- och sjukvården (HSL) inom dessa verksamhetsområden. Karlstads kommun med ingående berörda nämnder utgör beställare i upphandlingen. Upphandligen efterfrågar en lösning med funktioner i drift på marknaden idag, men som också tillsammans med kommunen kan möta framtidens utmaningar på området. Lösningen upphandlas som Saas enligt kommunens definition. I Leverantörens åtagande ingår implementering av system (inklusive deltagande i migrering från Kommunens befintliga system), utbildningsinsatser, löpande drift, support/underhåll, vidarutveckling, partnerskap och samskapande under hela avtalsperioden.
